lines.en: Wanda, look at these old letters. My grandmother had written them before she moved here, long before the internet existed.
lines.pt: Wanda, olhe estas cartas antigas. Minha avó as havia escrito antes de se mudar para cá, muito antes de a internet existir.

lines.en: Beautiful handwriting! By the time I was ten, I had never sent a real letter. I had only used email.
lines.pt: Que letra bonita! Aos dez anos, eu nunca tinha enviado uma carta de verdade. Só tinha usado e-mail.

lines.en: Before the internet, people had relied on the post for everything. News had taken weeks to arrive.
lines.pt: Antes da internet, as pessoas dependiam do correio para tudo. As notícias levavam semanas para chegar.

lines.en: When my father emigrated, his family had waited a month for his first letter. They had worried constantly.
lines.pt: Quando meu pai emigrou, a família dele esperou um mês pela primeira carta. Eles tinham ficado preocupados o tempo todo.

lines.en: And this stamp is from 1975. Someone had stuck it on the envelope, but the sender had forgotten the address!
lines.pt: E este selo é de 1975. Alguém o havia colado no envelope, mas o remetente tinha esquecido o endereço!

lines.en: So the parcel had never reached the recipient. Imagine waiting for years for something that had been lost.
lines.pt: Então o pacote nunca chegou ao destinatário. Imagine esperar anos por algo que tinha se perdido.

lines.en: By the time email became popular, most people had stopped writing letters. I think it is a pity.
lines.pt: Quando o e-mail se popularizou, a maioria já tinha parado de escrever cartas. Acho uma pena.

lines.en: I agree, but I had not realised how much I missed it until I held these. It feels so nostalgic.
lines.pt: Concordo, mas eu não tinha percebido quanto sentia falta até segurá-las. Dá uma saudade enorme.

lines.en: After I had read the first one, I wanted to keep them all. They are a real keepsake of her life.
lines.pt: Depois de ler a primeira, quis guardar todas. São uma verdadeira lembrança da vida dela.

lines.en: Why not write back to someone? By the end of this week, I will have sent three letters.
lines.pt: Por que não escrever para alguém? Até o fim desta semana, terei enviado três cartas.

lines.en: Great idea. I had never thought about writing a note by hand until today, but you have convinced me.
lines.pt: Ótima ideia. Eu nunca tinha pensado em escrever um bilhete à mão até hoje, mas você me convenceu.

facts.label: Past perfect
facts.sub: Ação anterior a outra no passado: People had written letters. Negativa: had not. Pergunta: Had they waited? Com before, after, by the time, until.

facts.label: Had not / Had…?
facts.sub: Negativa: I had not realised. Pergunta: Had they waited? Resposta curta: Yes, they had. No, they had not. A estrutura é fácil: had + sujeito + particípio.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Com by the time, before, after, until e when, use past perfect para a ação mais antiga: By the time I arrived, they had left. A outra ação fica no past simple.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past perfect is had + past participle.
We say “She had wrote the letters”.
It shows an earlier past action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past perfect is had + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She had wrote the letters”. → Falso (We say had written.)
It shows an earlier past action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Letters from before the internet · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy afternoon at a post office in Auckland. Kai has come to collect a box of old things. His friend Nina keeps him company. Inside the box there is old correspondence and some stamps. Some of them are fifty years old. Kai begins to read aloud.

“Nina, look at these old letters. My grandmother had written them before she moved here, long before the internet existed.” says Kai. “Beautiful handwriting! By the time I was ten, I had never sent a real letter. I had only used email.” says Nina. “Before the internet, people had relied on the post for everything. News had taken weeks to arrive.” says Kai.
